name: Monaco no Kyuujitsu ~Bara to Ai no Princess~
original_name: モナコの休日〜薔薇と愛のプリンセス〜
source:
You, a 26-year-old flower shop assistant, have just left your job to pursue your passion: to become a floral designer. To begin a new page in your life, you have planned a trip Monaco - the European country in your dreams - famous for the late Princess Leticia and her Highness' rose gardens.

On your way to the rose gardens of your dream, you have encountered 5 elegant young men, who turn out to be the Princes of Monaco - grandsons of Princess Leticia, and candidates of the next "Soverign Prince".

Unexpectedly, you are invited to the royal ball in the Palace. Just as you gaze at the glamorous night view of the Monte Carlo Harbor, a petal of rose fell softly before your steps.

"Would you be so kind as to honor me with your rose? My Princess..."

Who will be the prince that dedicated his rose to you?

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.koyonapps.monaq.novel]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你是一名26歲的花店店員，剛剛辭職，準備追逐自己的夢想，成為一名花藝設計師。為了翻開人生新篇章，你計畫前往夢想中的歐洲國家摩納哥；那裡以已故萊蒂西婭公主以及殿下的玫瑰花園聞名。

前往夢想中的玫瑰花園途中，你遇見五名優雅的年輕男子。他們竟然是摩納哥的王子——萊蒂西婭公主的孫子，也是下一任「親王」的候選人。

你意外受邀參加宮殿舉辦的皇室舞會。就在你凝視蒙特卡洛港迷人的夜景時，一片玫瑰花瓣輕輕落在腳邊。

「公主殿下，您願意賞臉，讓我把您的玫瑰獻給您嗎？」

哪位王子會把自己的玫瑰獻給你？
